U01.label: Rate mode
U01.tooltip: 1: Rate is particles per second (all Nadeo effects). 0: the rate is ignored and far more particles are emitted (tested in game). 2 looked like 1.

U03.tooltip: Integer. Nadeo: Fogger8M 5, Fogger16M/TorchSmoke 50, Sparkler 3, SparklerEnd 1, InFog 10. 1 and 50 showed no visible difference in game.

U04.label: Rate
U04.tooltip: Particles per second (with Rate mode 1), tested in game. Nadeo: Fogger8M 50, TorchSmoke 10, Sparkler8m 200.

U08.label: Max particles
U08.tooltip: Particle pool size, tested in game: 10 gives slow emission with large gaps. Nadeo: Fogger 1000, Sparkler8m 100, InFog 300.

U10.label: Vertical speed
U10.tooltip: Added upward velocity (negative = downward), tested in game. Unused by Nadeo.

U11.label: Speed
U11.tooltip: Initial velocity along the emission direction, tested in game. Nadeo: Fogger8M 8, TorchSmoke 0, Sparkler8m 20, Sparkler16m 40.

U12.label: Speed variation
U12.tooltip: Also speed related, probably its random variation, found by testing in game. Nadeo: Fogger8M 1, TorchSmoke 0, Sparkler8m 10.

U13.label: Cone angle
U13.tooltip: Half angle of the emission cone, tested in game: 0 straight jet, 90 hemisphere, 180 full sphere. Nadeo: Fogger 0/3.8, Sparkler 6, SparklerEnd8m 180.

U15.label: Emission shape
U15.tooltip: Selects the shape parameters below, tested in game. 1: foggers/smoke, 2: sparklers. 3 (box) and 4 are not used by Nadeo; 4 showed no particles in game.

U17.label: Axial spread
U17.tooltip: Shape 1. 20 gave a much longer jet that starts transparent and breaks up later (particles born further along the axis). Nadeo: TorchSmoke 0.15, Fogger16M 0.02, InFog 2.

U16.tooltip: Shape 1. 2, 20 and -20 showed no visible difference in game. Nadeo: TorchSmoke 0.15, InFog 1.

U18.tooltip: Shape 1. 5 and 20 showed no visible difference in game. Nadeo: InFog 94.

U19.tooltip: Shape 1. 5 and 20 showed no visible difference in game. Nadeo: InFog 94.

U20.label: Ring radius
U20.tooltip: Shape 2: particles spawn on a ring of this radius around the emission axis, tested in game.

U21.label: Ring width
U21.tooltip: Shape 2: radial thickness of the ring (radius 0 + width 1 = filled circle), tested in game. Nadeo: Sparkler 0.04, SparklerEnd 1.

U22.label: Axial start
U22.tooltip: Shape 2: start of the spawn range along the emission axis (-6 spawns behind the emitter), tested in game. Nadeo: SparklerEnd -3/-6.

U23.label: Axial end
U23.tooltip: Shape 2: end of the spawn range along the emission axis (4 spawns between 0 and +4 m), tested in game. Nadeo: SparklerEnd 4.

U24.tooltip: Shape 2. 2 and -2 showed no visible difference in game.

U25.label: Arc angle
U25.tooltip: Shape 2: part of the ring that emits (90 quarter, 180 half, 360 full), tested in game. Nadeo: 360.

U26.label: Swirl
U26.tooltip: Shape 2: particles fly outwards and rotate around the axis, tested in game. Nadeo: SparklerEnd16m 0.5.

U27.label: Outward speed
U27.tooltip: Shape 2: outward cone, slightly smaller than Swirl, tested in game.

U28.label: Box (centre, size)
U28.tooltip: Shape 3: centre x y z then full size x y z in Trackmania axes, tested in game. Sideways centre offsets work, a centre height (y) was ignored in game.

U29.tooltip: Shape 4 showed no particles in game.

U30.tooltip: Shape 4 showed no particles in game.

U31.tooltip: Shape 4 showed no particles in game.

U32.tooltip: Shape 4 showed no particles in game.
